newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-QNI records fall in nickel output.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-QNI records fall in nickel output.

text.p: Queensland-based nickel producer QNI Ltd said on Tuesday that second quarter production was affected by weather and labour problems and fell 22.9 percent from the year-earlier period to 6,613 tonnes.

"Continued disruptions to ore supplies from mine sites at Gebe Island, Indonesia, and New Caledonia as a result of poor weather conditions and industrial action have impacted on production levels in the December quarter," the company said.
Conditions at the mines, particularly in New Caledonia, have improved slightly since the September quarter and production of both nickel and cobalt are up on the previous quarter, it said.
Cobalt production in the December quarter reached 417 tonnes versus 341 in the corresponding period a year ago due to treatment of higher-grade ore and improvements in refining.
QNI said on January 14 that it expected its profits for the first half to be considerably lower because of the disruptions to ore supplies coupled with lower metals prices.
QNI refines nickel and cobalt at its Yabulu refinery in Townsville, Queensland.
